description: Return the drawing guide: XML format, layout, edge routing, style and editing rules. start_session already returns it; call this only if the guide is no longer in your context. With topic, returns a short XML reference for tables, layers or groups, or the drawing guide of a diagram type (sequence, swimlane, swimlane-horizontal, usecase): call that before drawing a diagram of the type.

topic.description: Return only this topic instead of the whole guide: tables, layers, groups, or a diagram type (sequence, swimlane, swimlane-horizontal, usecase).

name: get_drawing_guide
title: Get drawing guide
